custom_steps:
1. In the Parts row of the line, click + Add Part, then click More options.
  2. Type the special-order number in Part Number.
  3. Click the X at the top right of the New Part Request window.
  4. Pick location B in the location selector at the top right.
  5. Click Work Orders in the top bar.
  6. Open work order 2 from the Work Orders list (Work Orders in the top bar).
  7. In the Parts row of the line, click + Add Part, then click More options.
  8. Type the special-order number in Part Number.
  9. Click the X at the top right of the New Part Request window.
